Class KeyDisplayValueSwingModel.Remodel

java.lang.Object
dev.visdb.seesaw.models.AbstractComboBoxListSwingModel.Remodel
dev.visdb.seesaw.models.KeyDisplayValueSwingModel.Remodel
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
Enclosing class:
KeyDisplayValueSwingModel<K,D,D2>
public class KeyDisplayValueSwingModel.Remodel extends AbstractComboBoxListSwingModel.Remodel
Add some additional methods for inspecting and modifying list info with key/displayValue/D2. See AbstractComboBoxListSwingModel.Remodel

This pattern should be used when working with the list to guarantee exclusive access. It avoids many potential synchronization problems. Nesting is OK. 

    try (Model.remodel remodel = keyVis.getRemodel()) {
        // ...
    }
When there is no locking, getRemodel() is fast; there is minimal overhead.
Since:
4.0.0
